# pve_guest_bulk_migrate (Action)

Bulk-migrate guests to other nodes on the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_guest_bulk_migrate" "example" {
  config {
  target = "CHANGE_ME"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_guest_bulk_migrate.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `target` (String) Target node.

### Optional

- `max_workers` (Number) Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. (default: 1)
- `maxworkers` (Number) Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. Deprecated, use 'max-workers' instead. (default: 1)
- `online` (Boolean) Enable live migration for VMs and restart migration for CTs.
- `vms` (List of Number) Only consider guests from this list of VMIDs.
- `with_local_disks` (Boolean) Enable live storage migration for local disk
